text:
Two stands stand out. I couldn't open the WIRED roundup, so this rests on the Macworld review and ESR's product page.

**Best overall: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W Charging Stand, $129.99**
- Macworld gave it an Editors' Choice award. Its reviewer says no rival "stand[s] as tall or [is] as adjustable."
- It charges an iPhone at up to 25W (Qi2.2), an Apple Watch at 5W with fast charging, and AirPods on a 5W pad.
- The pad has a weighted hinge and a 160-degree viewing angle.
- It folds up and comes with a 45W adapter that has US, UK and EU plugs.
- It weighs 399g, so it suits a desk better than a travel bag.
- Buy it at [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V) or [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html).

**Cheaper option: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W, about $82 with a code**
- It lists at $99.99. The code `PARTNER18` takes off $17.99, bringing it to $82. The code expires 2026-12-31, and the final price is whatever your checkout shows.
- It has a cooling fan for the iPhone pad, an Apple Watch pad, an AirPods pad and a 50W adapter.
- It gets the full 25W only on the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- ESR doesn't publish its dimensions. It has a 12-month warranty (24 months if you register) and 30-day returns.
- A 15W version costs $79.99.
- [Buy the ESR CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is a commission link, and it doesn't cost you extra.

**Which to pick:**
- Choose the **Satechi** if you want an adjustable, taller stand that folds for travel.
- Choose the **ESR** if you want 25W charging with a fan for less money, mainly for a nightstand.

Before you buy, check which iPhone you have. Only newer models get the full 25W, and older ones charge at 15W on either stand.

**Price:** $129.99, the same as the 15W predecessor. The review also notes a $79.99 Satechi 2-in-1 charger for people without an Apple Watch.

- **iPhone:** Up to 25W via Qi2.2 wireless charging
- **Apple Watch:** 5W, enough for fast charging
- **AirPods:** 5W pad

**Pros:**
- Charges iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods
- Apple Watch fast charge
- Adjustable charging pad with a weighted hinge (160-degree viewing angle)
- Stands taller than rival foldable chargers
- Folds for travel
- Includes a 45W power adapter with US, UK, and EU plugs

**Cons:**
- Smaller, lighter alternatives exist
- Heavier than rivals at 399g, so it's better suited to desk use than travel
